label: D2 after a2->S2 (common) following a rewarded a2 trial, early in the episode (trials <25)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition, with the previous trial rewarded and (almost always) the previous choice also a2, i.e. a rewarded a2 streak continuing. Never fires on a1, on S1, or on rare transitions. Strongly gated by episode time: all activity is in episode trials 3-29, none after trial ~30, so it is a transient early-episode reset-gate response (also enriched for episodes that start with S2 good, value-head output in its top bin, policy strongly favouring a2). Recall ~1.0 but precision ~0.6: many same-condition steps in that window are silent, especially long uninterrupted rewarded a2/S2c runs; no observed variable cleanly separated these. All predicate variables are observable at D2 (ep_trial only as elapsed time). Magnitude was not systematically checked; top examples are the first a2->S2c after a stretch of rare/unrewarded trials.
